title: Brand mark
responsibility: Draws the modular Harness H using the surrounding text color.

inputs.name: BrandMark.size
inputs.description: Sets both SVG width and height attributes, defaulting to "1em"; the implementation accepts a number or string without further validation.

inputs.name: BrandMark.label
inputs.description: A nonempty value supplies aria-label and sets role="img"; an empty value leaves role unset and sets aria-hidden="true", and the default is an empty string.

outputs.name: BrandMark
outputs.description: Renders SVG markup for the modular H using the shared grid and tiles, currentColor, and size for both dimensions. A nonempty label exposes it as a named image; an empty label keeps it decorative and hidden from assistive technology.
